item.question: Compare 2 l 50 ml and 2,500 ml. Then compare 600 ml + 700 ml with 1 l 300 ml. Use <, = or >. These are practice values.
steps: Change both capacities to ml. 2 l 50 ml is 2 × 1,000 + 50 = 2,050 ml.
The other capacity is 2,500 ml. 2,050 is less than 2,500.
So 2 l 50 ml < 2,500 ml.
Work out the sum first: 600 + 700 = 1,300 ml.
1,300 ml and 1,300 ml are the same, so 600 ml + 700 ml = 1 l 300 ml.
Check: 2,500 − 2,050 = 450, so the second capacity is 450 ml more.
item.answer: 2 l 50 ml < 2,500 ml, and 600 ml + 700 ml = 1 l 300 ml
